title: Receiving Christ
definition: Receiving Christ is the faith-response of welcoming, trusting, and resting in Jesus as Savior and Lord.
summary: Receiving Christ means personally embracing Jesus as Savior, Lord, and the gift of God offered in the Gospel.
christFocus: Jesus Christ gives the right to become children of God to those who receive and believe in Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Receiving Christ means personally embracing Jesus by faith as He is offered in the Gospel. Scripture does not speak of salvation as merely admiring Jesus from a distance, but as coming to Him, trusting Him, and belonging to Him.

To receive Christ is to receive the Savior, Lord, and life He gives. It is not grabbing one benefit while rejecting His person.

Jesus gives the right to become children of God to those who receive Him. The gift is Christ Himself, and all saving blessings are found in Him.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because people may appreciate Christian ideas without entrusting themselves to Christ. Receiving Christ clarifies that salvation is personal faith in the living Savior, not vague approval of religious truth.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Come to Christ Himself, not merely to church culture, moral advice, or spiritual comfort. Call others to receive the whole Christ with empty hands, trusting Him for forgiveness, life, and lordship.
